meta.title: The Star Workshop
meta.story: Restore an old sky machine and bring the missing constellations back. Travel for its parts, experiment with bursts and multiballs, and take as many shots as you need.

chapters.title: The Star Workshop
chapters.story: Restore an old sky machine and bring the missing constellations back. Travel for its parts, experiment with bursts and multiballs, and take as many shots as you need.

finale.title: The Constellations Come Home
finale.story: The repaired sky machine turns above the garden. Every part of your journey has become a new line of light, and the missing constellations return one after another. The workshop door stays open for the next curious visitor.

levels.title: The Quiet Observatory
levels.story: The old sky machine has stopped, leaving several constellations dark. Clear the dust from its entrance and step into a workshop that is waiting for a patient pair of hands. Collect the Ghost ball and Super guide pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; open a line through the peg lanes.

levels.title: A Faded Star Map
levels.story: A faded map shows where the machine’s missing parts were scattered. Build enough light to read its first directions and turn a distant collection of places into a plan. Collect the Multiball and Echo ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; spread the next launch across both sides.

levels.title: The Moon Gear
levels.story: The lunar room holds a great silver gear behind a field of old pegs. Clear the field and let the bouncing plate keep your experiments moving until the gear is free. Collect the Blast ball and Ghost ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; aim the first burst into a cluster.

levels.title: Aurora Coils
levels.story: Loose coils hum beneath the northern lights. Build a flowing chain of bounces to charge them gently; their captured color will become the sky machine’s new wiring. Collect the Fireball and Blast ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; burn a route through the crowded lanes.

levels.title: The Frost Key
levels.story: A maintenance key has frozen into the mountain stores. Clear the surrounding pegs and use the friendly burst to open a path through the frost without rushing. Collect the Echo ball and Magnet ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; use a second trip through the board.

levels.title: Valley Resonator
levels.story: A deep bell in the alpine valley can steady the machine’s rhythm. Clear its old fittings and listen for the note that will keep all the new parts working together. Collect the Magnet ball and Multiball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; bring falling balls back toward the plate.

levels.title: Mirror on the Lake
levels.story: The machine needs a mirror as calm as the lake. Build a bright score across the reflections until the workshop’s polished mirror rises from its sheltered case. Collect the Super guide and Magnet ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; read the longer bounce preview before launching.

levels.title: The River Wheel
levels.story: An abandoned waterwheel can supply the workshop with steady power. Clear its blocked channels and let several balls test the new route through the turning mechanism. Collect the Ghost ball and Echo ball and Blast ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; open a line through the peg lanes.

levels.title: Prism Falls
levels.story: Clear crystals sparkle in the spray beneath the falls. Gather enough pieces to build a prism that can split one lamp into the many colors of a constellation. Collect the Fireball and Super guide and Multiball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; burn a route through the crowded lanes.

levels.title: The Forest Frame
levels.story: The forest carpenters have saved a strong frame for the sky machine. Clear the pegs around its joints so they can carry the whole frame back to the workshop. Collect the Magnet ball and Blast ball and Echo ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; bring falling balls back toward the plate.

levels.title: Bamboo Air Pipes
levels.story: Bamboo pipes will help the machine breathe as its wheels turn. Build a gentle rhythm of points to tune the pipes and keep their notes clear from end to end. Collect the Super guide and Multiball and Magnet ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; read the longer bounce preview before launching.

levels.title: Blossom Chimes
levels.story: Chimes among the blossoms can mark each turn of the main gear. Clear their tangled fittings and free a small, bright sound for every step of the machine’s cycle. Collect the Fireball and Blast ball and Echo ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; burn a route through the crowded lanes.

levels.title: Meadow Wind Vanes
levels.story: Soft meadow winds are perfect for testing the new vanes. Clear the test field and watch multiballs trace the different paths the wind can take through the workshop. Collect the Magnet ball and Ghost ball and Super guide pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; bring falling balls back toward the plate.

levels.title: Copper Leaf Cogs
levels.story: Copper-colored leaves reveal a box of spare cogs. Build a rustling score to sort the useful pieces and complete the connection between the wheel and the star map. Collect the Multiball and Echo ball and Magnet ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; spread the next launch across both sides.

levels.title: The Sun Battery
levels.story: The desert station stores sunlight for long winter nights. Clear its protective pegs and collect a steady charge that will keep the constellations shining after sunset. Collect the Ghost ball and Blast ball and Super guide and Echo ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; open a line through the peg lanes.

levels.title: Canyon Alignment
levels.story: Echoes in the canyon reveal whether each part is aligned. Clear the testing pegs and let returning balls trace the paths that the machine’s light should follow. Collect the Magnet ball and Multiball and Fireball and Super guide pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; bring falling balls back toward the plate.

levels.title: The Ember Core
levels.story: A cooled volcanic workshop holds the machine’s missing ember core. Build a warm glow around its case until the safe, steady core is ready for the journey home. Collect the Fireball and Ghost ball and Blast ball and Magnet ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; burn a route through the crowded lanes.

levels.title: The Reef Lens
levels.story: The sea-watchers have polished a final lens beneath the reef. Gather its clear crystals and fit them around the prism so every line of light reaches the right star. Collect the Echo ball and Multiball and Super guide and Ghost ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; use a second trip through the board.

levels.title: Lagoon Test Flight
levels.story: The lagoon offers a wide mirror for one last test. Build a bright score across its reflected sky and check that bursts, gears, lenses, and chimes all work together. Collect the Magnet ball and Blast ball and Fireball and Echo ball pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; bring falling balls back toward the plate.

levels.title: Stars Above the Garden
levels.story: Every repaired part is back in place above the garden workshop. Clear the final test board, turn the great moon gear, and welcome the missing constellations home. Collect the Ghost ball and Blast ball and Multiball and Super guide pegs near the entrance to charge the next shot; open a line through the peg lanes.
